definitions.explanation: The soft, curly fiber obtained from sheep, used as a textile material for clothing, blankets, and other products.

notes:
The standard term for sheep's wool as a raw material or textile fiber. Commonly seen on clothing labels and in descriptions of textile products.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {羊毛|ようもう}100%: 100% wool
- {羊毛|ようもう}フェルト: wool felt
- {羊毛|ようもう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{産地|さんち}→産地：04031_sanchi⟧: wool-producing area
- {羊毛|ようもう}⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧: wool products
- {羊毛|ようもう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{刈|か}る→刈る：02043_karu⟧: to shear wool

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ウール→ウール：27712_uuru⟧: wool (loanword from English; common in fashion and retail)
- ⟦{毛糸|けいと}→毛糸：00212_keito⟧: knitting yarn, woolen yarn
- ⟦{毛織物|けおりもの}→毛織物：15572_keorimono⟧: woven wool fabric
